# Code of conduct

Be decent to people. Assume the person on the other end is trying to make something work.

Specifically:

- Criticize the work, not the person. "This change makes the snare click at a short decay" is useful. "This is obviously wrong" is not.
- Report what you observed, not what you assume: the version, the plugin or the FM-1, and what you did.
- Do not pressure anyone into flashing firmware onto a device they can't afford to lose.
- No harassment, personal attacks, or unwelcome attention of any kind.
- Do not post other people's kits without their permission, or anyone's personal information, including your own by accident.

## If something goes wrong

Report it to the maintainer privately by email. Reports are handled as discreetly as circumstances allow. Unacceptable behaviour can result in comments being removed, a pull request being closed, or a contributor being blocked.

The maintainer holds themselves to the same standard, and can be told when they fall short of it.
